task.instruction: Prioritize a triage model for a service desk handling routine requests and context-heavy access failures.
task.deliverable: A first implementation choice, mandatory escalation boundary, and evidence grounding.

evidence.content: Synthetic logs contain 420 routine requests with stable categories and 37 access failures whose causes vary across device, policy, and account state.
A synthetic access-recovery protocol requires escalation after two unresolved denial attempts because device, policy, and account causes remain indeterminate without a higher-level review.
A fixed rubric agrees with senior review on 96% of routine cases but only 70% of access failures; bounded notes raise access agreement to 89%.

A.content: When repeatability and auditability dominate, make the decision sequence and required checks explicit.

B.content: When conditions vary in consequential ways, preserve bounded judgment to adapt the decision to observed context.

irrelevant.content: Use one capitalization style for all section headings.
